readBackRecords.title: Contest submission and evidence readiness
readBackRecords.body: Release Word Pairs as a verified guest multiplayer contest project with accurate provenance, retained review evidence and an entrant-controlled submission.
readBackRecords.notes: Operator contest/compliance/HV retention instructions, 27October2026. Source and scope: docs/submission/README.md; official rules PDF and hash: docs/submission/rules-receipt.json; HV originals: docs/submission/hv-index.json. Exact criterion references use TR-CONTEST-READINESS-041#CONTEST-01..05. Pending authenticated mission/conduct text, entrant facts, final URL/real live matrix, Work provenance and manual entry. No agreement or entry performed. Existing FR/TR/TEST obligations remain in force.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Before release, retain exact official-rule source/hash, resolve mission/conduct requirements and entrant eligibility, and use the earlier documented cutoff; do not assert unknown compliance.

At the final stable public HTTPS URL, clean guests on phone/laptop can join by code without required sign-in or install, complete synchronized games and replay; fulfill existing TEST-ROOMSYNC-139 rather than substituting fixture evidence.
Retain accurate ChatGPT Work design/build provenance and authenticated mission completion evidence; Codex-only activity does not establish the named workflow.

Prepare title, licensed cover, accurate description and playable URL; the eligible entrant manually submits through the actual Handshake mission before the cutoff, with no automated entry or unapproved agreement acceptance.

Retain every available hostile-validation receipt including rejected/superseded rounds, labeled reconstructions, corrections, candidate hashes and evidence limits; bind final approval and release/source/SWBOM evidence to the submitted candidate without exposing secrets.

readBackRecords.condition: Audit the final release, incorporated rules, entrant prerequisites and evidence package against each TR-CONTEST-READINESS-041 criterion; report every unresolved dependency before manual entry.
